An environmental monitoring network deploys nine wireless sensors across three regional clusters, each cluster arranged as an equilateral triangle with 2-meter sides. Cluster A: A1(0,0), A2(2,0), A3(1,1.7). Cluster B: B1(4,0), B2(6,0), B3(5,1.7). Cluster C: C1(8,0), C2(10,0), C3(9,1.7), with all coordinates in meters. Any two sensors within 2.05 meters of each other interfere and cannot transmit simultaneously on the shared channel. Using these coordinates and the 2.05-meter interference radius, construct the conflict graph (note that within each cluster all three sensors are mutually within range, and additionally sensor A2 is within range of sensor B1, and sensor B2 is within range of sensor C1, while all other cross-cluster pairs exceed the radius).
